Epic acceptance criteria: | BW-003-AC-2 | Implementation scope | Extend the same checker with --suite context and a finite test-only probe owner under tests/runtime_fixtures/. It owns only disposable probe entities, a logical tick/clock, bounded scheduled inputs and an observable non-economic action counter/revision. The probe is the user-selected early experiment: no production character state, combat executor, transport or database is introduced. | Use FixtureWorldContext exactly: required server_tick, UTC server_time, owner_epoch, world_configuration_id, opaque string random_seed and explicit visible_entities/npc_states/parties collections. Supply a tiny pinned same-floor/collision fixture and context/content hashes; empty collections represent a known empty state, not missing configuration. Resolve seed-to-generator initialization deterministically without narrowing the canonical string seed to an invented wire encoding. Support the FixtureStep ability_command follow-up variant with its canonical timing and payload, and reuse the needed FixtureAssertion scope/idempotency forms. Unsupported valid variants reject explicitly before execution; no cast, NPC, group or transfer behavior is fabricated.

Epic acceptance criteria: | BW-003-AC-4 | Implementation scope | Add --suite metrics to measure the same finite test probe. Collect monotonic elapsed processing duration for each actual probe tick, relevant probe-entity counts and current/peak depth of the queue actually consumed by that probe. Keep scheduling interval, processing duration, wall time and the existing bootstrap heartbeat distinct. Supply idle, active and queued-burst workloads with finite declared entity/client/step/tick bounds. | Use at least two logical recipient clients and count the exact UTF-8 serialized probe payload bytes produced per recipient over a declared measurement window. Preserve per-recipient totals and disclose the aggregation policy, direction, units, warm-up and sample/percentile calculation. Label these serialized payload bytes, with logical-client counts and no network transport; they are not wire traffic, RTT, protocol overhead or capacity evidence. Include zero-client and unequal-recipient controls without dividing by zero or inventing traffic.

Hard prerequisites: | BW-003-T02 | Acceptance criteria | AC 1 | An actual bounded run captures raw finite nonnegative probe-tick processing durations, declared relevant probe-entity counts, per-logical-recipient serialized payload byte totals and the real probe queue depth, joined to its workload, context and environment.
